outlook.statement: The Directors are continuously looking for the new avenues for future growth of the Company and expect more growth in the future period.

To expand our business, we intend to strengthen our presence in the domestic market by expanding our distribution and sales network and adding new customers across various regions. We aim to leverage the growing demand for kitchen utensils, cookware and household kitchen products driven by urbanization, rising disposable incomes, changing lifestyles and increasing consumer preference for durable and hygienic products. We also intend to diversify our product portfolio by introducing innovative, quality and value-added products to cater to changing customer requirements. With the increasing penetration of organized retail, e-commerce and modern trade, we aim to enhance our market reach and brand visibility. Further, we intend to explore opportunities in institutional, hospitality and other emerging markets and focus on improving operational efficiency, product quality and customer service to achieve sustainable growth.

risks: Raw Material Price Volatility: Fluctuations in the prices and availability of key raw materials may impact the Company's manufacturing costs, margins and overall profitability.

Demand and Market Competition: The Company operates in a highly competitive market with the presence of organized brands, regional manufacturers and unorganized players, which may create pressure on pricing and market share.
Low-Cost Imports: Availability of competitively priced imported kitchenware products may affect the Company's ability to maintain pricing and margins in certain product categories.

Regulatory and Compliance Risks: Changes in applicable laws, regulations, statutory requirements and industry standards may increase compliance obligations and associated costs and may require timely adaptation of business processes.
Energy and Manufacturing Costs: Variations in energy costs, manufacturing expenses, logistics costs and other operating inputs may affect the Company's cost structure and operating margins.
Distribution Risk: Dependence on dealers, distributors and retail channels may impact the Company's ability to expand its market presence and ensure consistent product availability.
Brand and Reputation Risk: Any adverse customer experience, product-related complaint or negative market perception may affect the Company's brand image and future business prospects.
Forward-looking statements involve identified/non-identified risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially
